# Vendored build-time tools for scripts/make-dmg.sh (never shipped in the app).
# One line per package: name, version, licence, licence file, SHA-256 of the PyPI source archive the code was copied from.
# The code is the unmodified src/<name>/ folder of that archive, plus its LICENSE. No pip, no venv, no network at build time.
# To update: download the new sdist, copy src/<name>/, replace this file's line in the same reviewed PR, run scripts/tests/run.zsh.
